name: Danavorexton
summary: Danavorexton (developmental code name TAK-925) is a selective orexin 2 receptor agonist. It is a small-molecule compound and is administered intravenously. The compound was found to dose-dependently produce wakefulness to a similar degree as modafinil in a phase 1 clinical trial. As of March 2021, danavorexton is under development for the treatment of narcolepsy, idiopathic hypersomnia, and sleep apnea.

pharmacology.text: Danavorexton (developmental code name TAK-925) is a selective orexin 2 receptor agonist. It is related to another orexin receptor agonist, firazorexton (TAK-994), the development of which was discontinued for safety reasons in October 2021.
pharmacology.kind: Orexin receptor agonist; Orexin OX2 receptor agonist; Wakefulness-promoting agent

sideEffects.en: It has only been tested in early trials. Reported effects included raised blood pressure and needing to urinate more often.
sideEffects.zh: 它只在早期試驗中測試過。被報告的作用包括血壓升高與頻尿。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它只在早期试验中测试过。被报告的作用包括血压升高与频尿。

fact.en: Orexin, the brain messenger it mimics, was discovered in 1998 by two teams at the same time, which is why it also has a second name, hypocretin. People with narcolepsy type 1 lose most of their orexin-making cells.
fact.zh: 它所模仿的腦部傳導物質食慾素，是 1998 年由兩個團隊同時發現的，因此它還有第二個名字「下視丘分泌素」。第一型猝睡症患者會失去大部分製造食慾素的細胞。
fact.zhHans: 它所模仿的脑部传导物质食欲素，是 1998 年由两个团队同时发现的，因此它还有第二个名字「下视丘分泌素」。第一型猝睡症患者会失去大部分制造食欲素的细胞。
